$comment: DESIGN-ONLY SharePoint List v2 schema for Escalation System v2. This file is a STATIC blueprint. It does NOT connect to, provision, or query SharePoint, Microsoft Graph, Dataverse, Azure, or any live service. It contains no tenant IDs, site URLs, client IDs, secrets, OAuth scopes, or Power Automate flows. See docs/SHAREPOINT_V2_BACKEND_READINESS.md and docs/BACKEND_ADAPTER_PLAN.md.
generatedBy: Loop 8 — SharePoint backend readiness without flows
namingConvention: All v2 lists are prefixed Escalations_v2_ to guarantee separation from the legacy Escalation Tracker list. v2 never reads or writes legacy lists.

columnTypeLegend.Lookup: Lookup to another v2 list (by that list's key column)
columnTypeLegend.Person: Native SharePoint Person-or-Group column (preferred for identities)

Escalations_v2_Tickets.title: Escalations v2 — Tickets
Escalations_v2_Tickets.description: Core ticket records. Maps to the v2 Ticket model (src/v2/domain/models.js).

fields.name: TicketKey
fields.notes: v2 primary key (e.g. esc_...). Distinct from the SharePoint item ID.

fields.name: AssignedDeptKey
fields.notes: Department/queue context — the departmentQueue owner.

fields.name: AssigneeKey
fields.notes: Person responsible for the work (assignedTo). Nullable.

fields.name: TicketOwnerKey
fields.notes: Closure authority — only this person may move the ticket to Complete. Distinct from AssigneeKey.

fields.name: ExpectedResolutionDate
fields.notes: Used for overdue/at-risk computation.

fields.name: CompletedDate
fields.notes: Set when status -> Complete; cleared on Reopened.

fields.name: TagKeys
fields.notes: Design choice pending D-decision: either a delimited list of tag keys OR a separate many-to-many link list. See readiness doc, open question OQ-3.

fields.name: LegacyItemId
fields.notes: Legacy SharePoint item ID, preserved on migration. Read-only reference only — no write-back to legacy.

fields.name: LegacyUrl
fields.notes: Legacy item URL, preserved for traceability. Never queried by v2.

fields.name: CreatedAt
fields.notes: App-level timestamp; distinct from SharePoint's built-in Created.

fields.name: ModifiedAt
fields.notes: App-level timestamp; distinct from SharePoint's built-in Modified.

computedNotInStorage.name: daysOpen
computedNotInStorage.notes: Always computed at read time (clamped >= 0). Never stored — legacy stored day-counts drifted.

Escalations_v2_Activity.title: Escalations v2 — Activity
Escalations_v2_Activity.description: Append-only audit/activity log. Immutable: corrections are new rows, never edits. Maps to ActivityEvent.

fields.name: ActorKey
fields.notes: Null for system/migration entries.

fields.name: FromValue
fields.notes: JSON-encoded old value.

fields.name: ToValue
fields.notes: JSON-encoded new value.

Escalations_v2_Comments.title: Escalations v2 — Comments
Escalations_v2_Comments.description: Public member/requester-facing comments. Separate stream from activity and internal notes. Maps to Comment.

fields.name: Mentions
fields.notes: Delimited list of user keys @-mentioned.

Escalations_v2_InternalNotes.title: Escalations v2 — Internal Notes
Escalations_v2_InternalNotes.description: Internal notes (not member-facing). Separate stream; carries visibility metadata for future permission gating. Maps to Note.

fields.name: Visibility
fields.notes: Metadata for future permission gating; not enforced in MVP.

fields.name: Color
fields.notes: Optional display color (not yet in the v2 model).

fields.name: ScopeDeptKey
fields.notes: Null = global tag.

Escalations_v2_Departments.title: Escalations v2 — Departments
Escalations_v2_Departments.description: Departments / queues, members, and leads. Maps to Department.

fields.name: LeadKeys
fields.notes: Delimited list of user keys (primary/backup leads).

fields.name: MemberKeys
fields.notes: Delimited list of user keys.

Escalations_v2_Users.title: Escalations v2 — Users (reference directory)
Escalations_v2_Users.description: Reference-user strategy. PREFERRED approach: use native SharePoint Person columns and resolve identities against Entra/SharePoint user info — NOT a hand-maintained user table. This list is a design fallback / mock-parity shim so MockStore's user objects have a 1:1 home and so lookups resolve in environments without directory access. No real directory data is embedded here.

fields.name: Email
fields.notes: Mock-only in the foundation; in production resolved via Person column, not stored free-text.

fields.name: DepartmentKeys
fields.notes: Delimited list of department keys this user belongs to.

fields.name: PersonRef
fields.notes: Native Person-or-Group column — the production identity anchor once directory access is approved (gated by D6/D7).

views.name: Open by Department
views.notes: Backs the department queue (includes person-assigned tickets).

views.name: My Assigned
views.notes: Backs the My Assigned Tickets panel.

recommendedIndexes.reason: SharePoint list-view threshold (5,000 items): filtered/sorted columns must be indexed to avoid throttling.
Activity grows fastest; per-ticket and per-type queries must stay indexed.

permissionModelAssumptions.note: Assumptions only — no permissions are configured by this file. Finalized under D6 (Entra app) before any live work.
assumptions: v2 lists live on a company-owned site/library, NOT a personal site, and separate from the legacy tracker.
Read access for queue members; write access scoped by department membership (enforced in the app/adapter layer for MVP, by list permissions later).
Owner-only Complete is an application-layer rule (domain/rules.js), not a SharePoint permission, in early phases.
Internal notes visibility is metadata today; future hardening may gate it via item-level permissions or a separate secured list.
No legacy list permissions are altered. v2 uses its own site and (per D6) its own app registration.
